text: S623 screened Open CAD Studio using only a synthetic R12 rectangle/line fixture. It renders the drawing and exposes DXF R14, but the browser Save As dialog provides no verifiable route to the required named C: folder; no product file or R14 output was made. This candidate preflight hold clears no V03 gate. Qualify a distinct local receiver workflow with destination control before supplying any product fixture. All G04/V03 criteria and holds remain unchanged. See E-G04-S623-EXIT and E-G04-S623-MATRIX.
